title: Project title
scope: Effective line-section model. Explicit width or idealized leg-based geometry; no normative factors or strength acceptance.
validation: The mathematical model has not yet been independently validated.
momentNotice: The resultant moment is nonzero. This stored result has no stress distribution; use Calculate to obtain a new result.
snapshot: Saved snapshot opened without recalculation. Press Calculate for a new result. Imported data requires review.
choose: Select a segment or right-click for editor commands.
source: Nominal static model of user-defined effective line elements. Strength is not assessed.
notDesktop: Run the desktop application to calculate and use the project database.
invalidNumber: All fields must contain finite numbers.
safety: Allowables, safety margins and compliance are not determined.
unsavedDescription: Save the current project before continuing?
dragHelp: Drag an endpoint or the whole weld line. Arrows: configured step; Shift: ×10. Alt: bypass snaps; Escape: cancel.
windowError: The window operation could not be completed.
settingsInvalid: Steps must be positive finite numbers; radius must be between 1 and 64 px.
settingsSaveError: Could not save settings. Please try again.
settingsLoadError: Could not load settings. Using defaults.
settingsHelp: Snaps override the movement step. Hold Alt while dragging to bypass snaps. Numeric input is exact. Snaps do not split intersecting welds.
navigationHelp: Wheel: zoom at cursor. Middle mouse button or Pan mode: move the view. Escape cancels the gesture. Ctrl+Z / Ctrl+Y: undo / redo outside text fields.
nominalHelp: Signed global components τx, τy, σz on the XY section. An affine nominal model, without local throat stresses or strength acceptance.
illConditioned: Bending not computed: the section is singular or ill-conditioned. Provide segments spread across the XY plane.
noWelds: Add a weld using the toolbar.
patternHelp: Pieces follow the selected weld from its start. Pitch must exceed length and the last piece must fit. Engineer-supplied dimensions; normative restrictions are not checked.
centreAfterCalculation: C position is available after calculation
loadPointOutside: Application point is outside this view
contourScope: Nominal model. Strength is not assessed.
templateOriginHelp: The bounding centre is not the effective section centroid for U and L groups.
templateInvalid: Enter positive dimensions and finite coordinates.
templateHelp: All segments will be replaced. Loads and cases remain; results require a new calculation. One Undo restores the previous group.
transformDirectionHelp: Positive angles turn counterclockwise in XY. The reference point is explicit, not an assumed section centroid.
transformPreviewHelp: Dashed: original group. Solid: transformed geometry.
transformHelp: Only weld geometry changes. Forces, couples and point P remain in global coordinates; all case results are cleared. One Undo restores the original state.
noForces: No forces. Add a force from the tree context menu.
copyWeldHelp: Original welds and loads are preserved. One transformed copy of the selected segment is added; Rust validates the combined group for intersections and overlaps. All case results are cleared. One Undo restores the original project.
layoutReadError: Layout could not be read. Default layout is in use.
layoutSaveError: Layout could not be saved. Change it again or restore the default layout.
filletAssumption: Idealized fillet: 90° root angle, straight face, no penetration or concavity allowance. Geometric throat from two legs; no GOST compliance or strength assessment. Initial sizes are an editable example.
sectionChanged: The weld changed during section calculation. Apply again.
sectionError: Section could not be derived. Check positive dimensions and numerical range.
massAssumption: F = m·(g − a): mass load acting on its attachment. Mass in kg; gravity g and translational acceleration a in m/s², in global axes. P is the centre of mass (or explicitly coincides with the section centroid). No rotational inertia, vibration or dynamic factors. Initial values are an editable example.
massChanged: The force changed during calculation. Apply again.
massError: Could not calculate mass load. Check mass and accelerations.
combinationAssumption: New case = sum of source loads with explicit user factors. Initial ones are editable examples, not normative values. Zero excludes a case; negative factors reverse its loads. Application points and source snapshots are preserved. This frozen case does not update when source cases change. Nested combinations are excluded.
combinationSnapshot: Frozen user load combination. Editing loads converts it to an ordinary case; Undo restores the combination. Source cases and factors are listed in the report.
combinationEditAssumption: Edit factors of the saved combination using frozen source loads, even if live source cases changed or were deleted. Case count and combination ID are retained; its result is cleared. Zero excludes a contribution. Create a new combination to use a different set of source cases.
materialScope: The common query context for both cards is explicit and is not inferred from weld width a. User-provided base and weld metal cards. Not a verified standards database. Thickness: (t min; t max], temperature: [T min; T max]. No interpolation; out-of-range properties are unknown. Properties do not yet affect nominal mechanics or strength. Source means a reference, clause or test record; do not paste publications.
userLimitsScope: Independent thresholds for nominal σz and |τxy|. Tension: max(σz,0); compression: max(−σz,0); shear: √(τx²+τy²). No component interaction, local throat or concentration check. Final limits and sources are user-provided; no material properties or factors are inserted automatically. Within limits does not mean normative strength acceptance.
widthStudyScope: Each factor scales every effective width. Both legs of an idealized fillet section scale proportionally. Coordinates, loads and material conditions remain fixed. Every case is recalculated. 1 is the original size; other factors are explicit. This compares nominal models, not normative sizing, weld volume/mass or strength acceptance. Select manually; only fully computed candidates can be applied. The table is temporary: save a PDF before applying to retain it.
quantityScope: Idealized right-triangle prisms: V = ½ k₁ k₂ L. Excludes reinforcement, penetration, intersections, losses and process allowances. Nominal effective area differs from triangle area. Mass uses applicable user-provided weld-metal density; unknown sections are not zero. No normative or purchasing-mass assessment.
quantityMissing: Total volume requires every section model; mass also requires applicable weld-metal density.
studyRankingScope: Selection only among supplied factors under independent user thresholds for every case. No normative sizing or global optimum; process constraints, costs and allowances excluded. Unknown data block automatic selection. Apply manually.
studyLimitsRequired: Selection requires explicit user tension, compression and shear thresholds.
